products.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Readiness Assessment & Deployment — Commercial
products.short_description: Roll out Microsoft 365 Copilot safely — assess readiness, fix the blockers, license and deploy, and prove value with a pilot.
products.description:
Roll out Microsoft 365 Copilot safely — assess readiness, fix the blockers, license and deploy, and prove value with a pilot.

Copilot inherits every permission and oversharing problem your tenant already has. This solution assesses technical and data readiness, remediates the blockers, licenses and assigns Copilot, and runs a measured pilot so leadership sees value before a broad rollout.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Readiness assessment — licensing, Entra, network, data hygiene, prerequisites
  • Blocker remediation plan (identity, oversharing, unsupported configs)
  • License assignment and Copilot enablement
  • Pilot cohort design with success metrics
  • Rollout waves and a value-measurement dashboard

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A Copilot rollout that's ready, safe, and measured — not a permissions incident waiting to happen.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CPLTREADY-AssignLicenses.ps1 — assign the Microsoft 365 Copilot SKU to the cohort/wave group members
    • CPLTREADY-Discovery.ps1 — Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness discovery for the scorecard
    • CPLTREADY-OversharingScan.ps1 — data-hygiene scan for broadly shared content (AI-exposure risk)
    • CPLTREADY-Report.ps1 — readiness-and-adoption report for the Copilot rollout
    • CPLTREADY-Validate.ps1 — pre-enablement validation of Copilot readiness for the cohort/wave

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
